variables.title: Memory and restart investigation
variables.log_evidence: This is ${truth.finding}'s own log line, and the highlighted message records its first catalog pod restart. The inventory showed its memory already high, so the rise came first.

demonstration.narration: I'll open this pod's logs to see whether rising memory came before its first restart.
demonstration.reasoning: A resource spike alone does not prove customer impact or causation. Matching its entity and timing to another observable signal tests the relationship.
